card.name: Linking words before listed conditions
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "of", "including" or a comma, right before a list of named conditions or topics. Mostly in warnings like "development of glaucoma" or "increased risks of stroke".

modes.label: "of" before adverse conditions
modes.description: The word "of" after development or risks, just before a named disease or complication.
modes.example: 5.3 Glaucoma and Cataracts Nasal and inhaled corticosteroids including RYALTRIS can result in the development<< of>> glaucoma and/or cataracts

modes.label: List openers in skin effects
modes.description: A comma or word piece inside a list of skin reactions.
modes.example: Local adverse reactions from topical corticosteroids may include atrophy<<,>> striae, telangiectas

modes.label: Author bio lists
modes.description: Words like "including" or "mathematical" introducing the titles or subjects of a person's work.
modes.example: His popular books,<< including>> Words and Rules and How the Mind Works
